title: NeoGenomics Scales AI Digital Pathology Infrastructure with Indica Labs
key_facts: NeoGenomics has expanded its partnership with Indica Labs to scale digital pathology infrastructure and speed AI-driven diagnostics.
NeoGenomics selected Indica Labs' HALO AP platform, a cloud-based, vendor-neutral image management system that can integrate third-party or in-house AI tools.
The expansion is also meant to prepare for testing demand from the antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) pipeline as AI-based biomarker tools emerge.
Warren Stone, president and chief operating officer of NeoGenomics, and Steven Hashagen, CEO of Indica Labs, are quoted from a release.
The relationship dates back to 2015; NeoGenomics is headquartered in Fort Myers, Florida, and runs CAP-accredited, CLIA-certified labs in the US and one facility in Cambridge, England.
HALO AP has CE-IVDR marking in Europe, the UK and Switzerland; in the US it is designated For Research Use Only and not FDA cleared for clinical diagnostic use.
The announcement was issued on 15 Oct 2026 (Business Wire); CLP covered it on 16 Oct.
quote_evidence: Under the agreement, NeoGenomics selected Indica Labs’ HALO AP platform to support its digital pathology operations through a scalable, cloud-based framework.

In the US, the platform is designated For Research Use Only and is not FDA cleared for clinical diagnostic use, while providing built-in compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, and GDPR regulations.
why_it_matters_hint: A big US cancer lab network is building its pathology work around a platform that can host AI tools.
